_dropped_details: Dropped ~13 mined/internal candidates that are not client-callable or are internal plumbing: Notification.markAsSeen/saveRecord/send (internal BaseNotification helpers; the HTTP surface is mark-all), Content.hardDelete (model-level cascade of soft delete, not an endpoint), ContentContainerBlockedUsers.updateByContainer + ContentContainerTagRelation.updateByContainer + ContentTagService.addTag (internal services), Search.rebuildIndex / PublishScheduledContents / PurgeDeletedContents (CLI/cron jobs), MysqlDriver.update (internal fulltext). Merged: Content.getAdminDeleteModal+Perma into get_content / get_content_permalink; Comment.show into list_comments; Like.showLikes into count_likes. Repurposed/misnamed: content_delete -> delete_content (state=100), content_move -> move_content, content_notificationswitch -> set_content_follow (Follow upsert).
